checkins.title: Check-in / out
checkins.draftHint: Choose deliverables with + beside a card’s checklist item.
checkins.agreedHint: You can add deliverables and update progress. Agreed items cannot be removed.
checkins.closedHint: This checkout is a saved record. Later card changes do not alter it.
checkins.emptyHint: Add checklist items from Cards to this cycle.
checkins.saveError: Could not save. The cycle may have been locked or the item changed. Refresh and try again.
checkins.progressHint: Completed / agreed deliverables, including later additions
checkins.confirmCheckin: This agrees the check-in for all members. Existing deliverables can no longer be removed; progress updates and later additions remain available.
checkins.confirmCheckout: This locks the checkout for all members. This cycle becomes a permanent snapshot and cannot be edited afterward.
